import sqlite3, json, os, statistics as st
for name in ("ob_wall5.db", "ob_wall6.db"):
    c = sqlite3.connect("file:/opt/trading-bot/%s?mode=ro" % name, uri=True)
    rows = c.execute("select exit_type, net_pct, net_usdt, hold_sec, lo_pct, hi_pct from trades").fetchall()
    n = len(rows)
    print("\n=== %s: сделок %d, net %+.3f$, средняя %+.3f%%, плюсовых %d (%.0f%%)" % (name, n, sum(r[2] for r in rows), 100*st.mean(r[1] for r in rows), sum(r[1] > 0 for r in rows), 100*sum(r[1] > 0 for r in rows)/n))
    g = {}
    for r in rows:
        k = "дошла до безубытка (be…)" if r[0].startswith("be") else r[0]
        g.setdefault(k, []).append(r)
    for k, v in sorted(g.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1])):
        print("  %-26s %3d шт  средний net %+.2f%%  сумма %+.3f$  средний мин %+.2f%% макс %+.2f%%" % (k, len(v), 100*st.mean(x[1] for x in v), sum(x[2] for x in v), st.mean(x[4] for x in v if x[4] is not None), st.mean(x[5] for x in v if x[5] is not None)))
c = sqlite3.connect("file:/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall6.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
print("\nрасстояние начального стопа от входа в ob_wall6 (из заявок, б.п.):")
import re
v = []
for (info,) in c.execute("select info from events where kind='buy_order'"):
    m = re.search(r"риск (\d+)", info or "")
    if m: v.append(int(m.group(1)))
print("  заявок %d: медиана %d б.п., от %d до %d" % (len(v), st.median(v), min(v), max(v)) if v else "  нет данных")
print("\n=== размеры файлов и рост")
for f in sorted(os.listdir(".")):
    if f.endswith(".db"): print("  %-40s %6.1f МБ" % (f, os.path.getsize(f)/1e6))
c7 = sqlite3.connect("file:/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall7.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
print("ob_wall7: zones по видам и жизни:")
rows = c7.execute("select kind, count(*), sum(t_last-t_first < 3), sum(t_last-t_first < 10), avg(t_last-t_first) from zones group by kind").fetchall()
for r in rows: print("  %-6s записей %5d | жили <3 с: %5d | <10 с: %5d | средняя жизнь %.1f с" % r)
print("  tape %d, zones %d" % (c7.execute("select count(*) from tape").fetchone()[0], c7.execute("select count(*) from zones").fetchone()[0]))
print("  размер ob_wall7 сейчас: %.1f МБ" % (os.path.getsize("ob_wall7.db")/1e6))
